TFA section time < 7.85 min
Individual section below floor (FIF<2.55, Val<0.22, TFA<6.67, Demo<0.95 min)
Rating block with >=4 items, >=80% answered, and SD < 0.15 — same answer repeated
Exact match on >=20 rating items with another record in same study
>=2 other records started within ±120 seconds in same study
TF-IDF cosine similarity > 0.90 on narratives (>=100 chars, >=20 words)
Impossible combinations: autistic > total children, age bands > child count, zero autism with gated follow-up answered

Item: What does a parent usually do in the situation pictured below? (Band-Aid attention check)
Flag: Not checking 'Puts on a Band-Aid' or checking that in addition to other responses
Mismatched pronoun and gender responses (e.g., selecting 'she' and 'man')
Reports 'No' disability but identifies >=1 autistic child
Record excluded pre-screening if any free-text field contains the standalone word 'test' (case-insensitive). Already applied as a source-level exclusion.
Responses consisting only of placeholder text ('n/a', 'asdf', '123', repeated characters like 'aaaa'). Short but valid answers should NOT be flagged.
Claimed education level is impossible given stated age (e.g., doctoral degree at age 20)
Same email address used across multiple study PIDs (not just within one study)
Primary email and confirmation email do not match — may indicate copy-paste error or intentional variation
Survey completed in under 5 minutes total — extremely unlikely for genuine respondent

Item: Child birth year vs parent birth year impossible interval
Flag: Parent was <10 or >60 years old at first child's birth — already partially in R9 but could be its own hard-exclusion rule

Item: Prenatal testing mutually exclusive branching violation
Flag: Answering both pregnant and non-pregnant follow-ups, or answering testing reasons without answering the prenatal gate

Item: Earlier diagnosis reason answered without gate
Flag: Submitting reasons for earlier diagnosis when respondent explicitly answered 'No' (or left blank) the gate question asking if child received an earlier diagnosis

Item: Country and Postal Code format mismatch
Flag: Selecting US residence but providing non-US/Canadian alphanumeric postal code, or obvious dummy ZIP ('00000', '12345', <5 digits)

Field Name: Email hash + demographic pattern + timing + response fingerprint
Flag: Multiple weak duplication signals combined (e.g., same email domain + similar timing + similar demographics without being the same person)

Item: Missing all timing data on complete survey
Flag: All 4 sections marked complete but zero section-timing fields available — review for data integrity
Number of children field contains non-numeric value or impossible number (e.g., 0 children for a 'caregiver' survey)
